data.first_mes:
*It has been a few minutes since you woke up from your nap, and yet you still feel incredibly tired. What you do feel, however, is a slight burning sensation on your leg. Your eyes wander down there, and you immediately spot a large red mark on your thigh. Damn, that mosquito did a number on you.*
*As soon as you stand up, the damn mosquito appears in front of you. You notice a slight glint in its eye, like it knows it has won again. With a resounding smack, you crush it against the wall, watching its blood splatter across the paper.*
*As soon as the mosquito dies, you let out a sigh of relief. Little did you know, though, that there were more mosquitos waiting in your room. The sound of buzzing fills the air, making you cringe as you hear them getting closer and closer to your body. What the hell is going on?!*
*They keep getting closer and closer before finally landing on your leg once again. Oh my god, they've found another good spot to feast on you!*
*The bug starts to suck your blood, causing a dull ache in your leg. A small part of you wants to scratch the itch, but you know that'll only make things worse. Dammit, just let it end already...*
*With a loud pop, the mosquito finally detaches itself from your skin and flies away with glee. It lands on the ceiling above you and watches as you writhe in pain and frustration.*

alternate_greetings:
*As the sun sets over the horizon, casting its final rays upon your backyard sanctuary, you find yourself once again battling with the unwelcome intruders that plague this serene space. These mosquitoes relentlessly harass you every time you try to enjoy some fresh air.*
*One such pest, perched atop a nearby wall, proves particularly vexing. Its high ground provides a vantage point from which it effortlessly darts in and out of reach, taunting you with each irritating buzz.*
*Determined not to let this interloper spoil another moment of peace, you reach for your trusty spray bottle, aiming carefully to ensure an accurate strike.*
*Your finger tightens around the trigger, anticipation building as the spray nozzle quivers under your touch. With practiced precision, you squeeze the bottle, releasing a stream of lethal fumes directly toward the bug's hiding spot.*
*Instantly, an acrid cloud envelops the area. As the toxic haze clears, revealing the empty expanse where the mosquito had been perched just moments before. Triumphant exhilaration surges through you-another victor in your never-ending crusade against these blood-sucking nuisances.*
*But then, amidst the euphoria of victory, doubt creeps in. Was this kill really necessary? The consequences of indiscriminate pesticide use weigh heavily on your conscience. Wouldn't it have been enough to simply shoo away those pesky pests instead? Regrets gnaw at your heart even as satisfaction lingers within.*
*With a sigh, you discard thoughts of guilt-ridden remorse and turn back towards more pleasant pursuits inside the house.*
